title: One LNS step on a pipe plan

blocks.text: The water utility of the previous practice now improves its plan with LNS. One step takes the current plan and a neighborhood, a set of project names, and re-plans the neighborhood while every other project stays as the plan has it.

`build(projects, budgets)` gives the whole plan model. Write first the step's model: which start variables it fixes, to which values, and which it leaves free. Then write `lns_step(projects, budgets, plan, free)` to solve it with HiGHS through MathOpt and return the better of the re-planned plan and `plan` (a dict from project name to start year). The tests use small plans whose best answers are known.

cases.says: a step that frees every project re-plans everything and finds the best plan
a project outside the neighborhood keeps its start, and one the plan leaves out stays out
a freed project may start in a different year, not only keep its year or drop out

origin.section: A Neighborhood Must Free Projects That Compete for the Same Money and Crews
